summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 29, 2026, announcing its full year 2025 financial results and operational updates. The filing details the completion of OwlPay's core infrastructure buildout, expansion of U.S. regulatory coverage to 40 state licenses, and key partnerships with Visa Direct and Cross River Bank. It highlights an increase in OwlPay Harbor enterprise clients from over 20 to 36, with aggregate annual payment volume exceeding US$6 billion. This is a routine earnings and business update, not a special situation. There is no mention of any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, or other event-driven transaction. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, providing financial results and progress updates. As a routine earnings release, it does not trigger any risk-arb or special-situation analysis.
